report: 图像中存在明显的噪声斑点，但噪声水平的测量结果接近随机（P(Fake)=0.56），无法提供明确的方向信息。尽管如此，我们已经尝试了噪声专家的测量，但结果并未提供足够的信息来确定图像的真实性或伪造性。图像中的噪声斑点可能是由于图像处理过程中的降噪、锐化或重压缩引起的，这使得仅凭噪声水平的测量无法得出结论。综合以上分析，我们无法得出图像是伪造的结论，也无法得出图像是真实的结论。因此，我们只能给出“不确定”的结论。

evidence.phenomenon: Whole-image noise-residual level 3.1483: the camera end of the G2 calibration band. Residual consistent with a camera sensor; a band is an association measured on the calibration set, not a physical proof of origin.
evidence.reasoning: Whole-image residual micro-noise level 3.1483 (intermediate). This is the band where the calibration set separates the two classes least, so the measurement carries little directional information; what produced the image, and how it was processed, is not recoverable from it.
evidence.interpretation_text: Calibration: this measurement band is near chance (P(Fake)=0.56) and does not determine a direction.
evidence.counter_explanation: 该指标衡量残差水平而非"不一致性"：G2 校准（格式配平，5 格）显示 Real 中位数 3.6 对 Fake 2.0，方向与原始"异常即伪造"的解释相反，且跨格式稳定（AUROC 0.15-0.23）。降噪、锐化与重压缩同样会改变该水平，故只应作为弱证据与校准似然配合使用。
evidence.applicability_conditions: 高 strength 统计上对应 Real（JPEG 压缩引入方差），不得按 AI-generated 解读；低 strength 侧（P(Fake)≈0.8）可作为弱证据使用。
evidence.interpretation_text_raw: Intermediate residual level; the calibrated likelihood is close to chance for this band.
